BENNETT

UNIVERSITY
THE TIMES GROUP

SCHOLARSHIP POLICY
Academic Year 2025-26

Purpose: Bennett University offers various scholarship schemes to attract a meritorious and diverse category of
students in specific programs as decided by the University.
Introduction:
The award of scholarship will be recommended by the Admission Committee, Fee Committee, or Finance Committee
and duly approved by the Executive Council. Seats and scholarships are allocated ona first-come, first-served basis and
are subject to availability at the time of fee payment. Early application and timely admission decisions improve
admission and scholarship prospects.
In cases where a student qualifies for multiple scholarships, the scholarship with the highest monetary value, as per
university guidelines, will be awarded to ensure fairness and alignment with policy.
The details of the scholarships offered will be included as part of the admission offer extended to candidates upon
selection.
Bennett University offers the following categories of Scholarships:

1. ON-ADMISSION SCHOLARSHIP

Bennett University offers the following categories of Scholarshi ps:
Admission Scholarships Includes Merit Scholarshi p, Sibling Scholarship, Single Girl Child Scholarship, Ward of Defence
Personnel Scholarship, Alumni Scholarship, and Times group employees (B Group companies) rebate.

2. ACADEMIC SCHOLARSHIP

For Students who were not eligible for on-admission scholarships during their admission at Bennett University.

1.1 MERIT SCHOLARSHIP FOR FIRST YEAR

The Bennett University offers Admission Scholarships to meritorious students for the first year of programs as decided
by the University. The decision for the scholarship is based on the candidate's scores in qualifying examinations and
other criteria as mentioned in Annexure A.

Procedure for Grant of Merit Scholarship
This scholarship shall be offered at the time of release of the offer letter as per the application submitted by the

candidate based on the approved criteria mentioned in Annexure A. The eligibility conditions shall be verified during
the document verification stage at the time of Registration.
The verified list of all eligible students for Merit Scholarships, along with the details of the scholarship offered and the
applicable documents, shall be reviewed by the Scholarship Committee com prising the following members:

(i) Registrar

{ii) VP Admissions & Marketing

(iii) Finance Controller

Withdrawal of Merit Scholarship
The scholarship shall be withdrawn at any time during a program, from the date as approved by the Competent

Authority, under the following conditions:

1.2 OTHER ADMISSION SCHOLARSHIPS

Includes Sibling Scholarship, Single Girl Child Scholarship, Ward of Defence Personnel Scholarship, Alumni Scholarship,
and Times Group Employee (B Group companies) Rebate. These scholarships will follow the same procedural
framework as Merit Scholarship.

1.2,1 SCHOLARSHIP FOR SINGLE GIRL CHILD

In order to promote single girl child education, Bennett University has introduced Single Girl Child scholarship with
effect from the Academic Year 2022-23 onwards, with an aim to compensate direct costs of girl education to all levels
especially for such girls who happen to be the only girl child in their family.

Amount of Scholarship

A total of 10% of the tuition fee is applicable for the single girl child in the family.

Procedure for Grant of Scholarship

The details of the scholarship offered will be part of the Admission Offer extended to candidates upon selection.
Candidates must enroll for the program by depositing the advance fee by the given due date in the admission offer
letter. Should a candidate fail to do so, the candidate shall have no claim over the scholarship. The Scholarship thereafter
shall be passed on to the next eligible candidate.

Documents Required
Copy of Ration Card/Family ID mentioning the names and relation of the family members. In absence of ration

card/Family ID, candidate shall provide a declaration on Non-Judicial Stamp Paper of INR 100/- as per the format
provided in Annexure B.

1.2.2 WARD OF DEFENCE PERSONNEL SCHOLARSHIP

To promote education for the wards of the serving / retired defence services and paramilitary personnel. This
scholarship is in addition to the Merit scholarship; however, the total scholarship amount must not exceed more than
100% of the tuition fees.

Amount of Scholarship:

A total of 5% of the tuition fee is offered to the ward of Defence Personnel.

Procedure for Grant of Scholarship:
The details of the Scholarship offered will be part of the Admission Offer extended to candidates upon selection.

Candidates must enroll for the program by depositing the advance fee by the given due date in the admission offer
letter. Should a candidate fail to do so, the candidate shall have no claim over the scholarship. The Scholarship thereafter
shall be passed on to the next eligible candidate.

The eligible student should produce a valid Armed /Paramilitary force's Identity Proof of his/her parent for claiming
the scholarship. Following documents in the respective category are mandatorily required to be submitted by the

applicant for applying Defence Forces Scholarship at Bennett University:

* Service Certificate to be issued by the respective Commanding Officer of the unit / Head of the Department
of respective headquarters, in case of serving personnel.

1.2.3 SIBLING SCHOLARSHIP
Sibling scholarship is offered to the siblings of current students of Bennett University for the duration of overlap of the
course of siblings and is applicable to wards of the same parents and not cousins. It recognizes the commitment and
support of families who have multiple siblings enrolled with us.
Amount of Scholarship
A scholarship amount of 10% is offered to the eligible students as Sibling Scholarship for the duration of the studies of
his/her real brother/sister studying at Bennett University.
Procedure for Grant of Scholarship:
The details of the Scholarship offered will be part of the Admission Offer extended to candidates upon selection.
Candidates must enroll for the program by depositing the advance fee by the given due date in the admission offer
letter. Should a candidate fail to do so, the candidate shall have no claim over the scholarship.
The offer releasing team shall confirm that the siblings are from the identical parents by checking the previous records.
The eligibility conditions shall be verified during document verification stage at the time of Registration and shall be
reviewed by the Scholarship Committee defined at para 1(b)} above,
Documents Required

. Pan Card / Aadhar Card / Passport of Sibling

1.2,4 ALUMNI SCHOLARSHIP
Alumni Scholarship is offered to the Alumnus of Bennett University (One who has qualified degree / diploma from

Bennett University and who opts to purse post graduate program from Bennett University having no adverse
disciplinary record.

Amount of Scholarship

Scholarship of 10% on tuition fee shall be offered to its Alumni by Bennett University to pursue any Post Graduate
Program in the University,

Procedure for Grant of Scholarship:
The details of the Scholarship offered will be part of the Admission Offer extended to candidates upon selection.

Candidates must enroll for the program by depositing the advance fee by the given due date in the admission offer
letter. Should a candidate fail to do so, the candidate shall have no claim over the scholarship.

The offer releasing team shall confirm that the Alumni Status of the interested student from Office Record.

The eligibility conditions shall be verified during document verification stage at the time of Registration and shall be
reviewed by the Scholarship Committee defined at para 1{b) above.

The student should have no adverse disciplinary issues. On occurrence of any proven disciplinary issue/remark, the

scholarship will be withdrawn for current semester, and no scholarship will be offered in subsequent semesters.

Documents Required

e PG/UG Degree Certificate issued by Bennett University

OTHER TERMS AND CONDITIONS FOR ALL THE SCHOLARSHIPS

a. Ifa student qualifies for multiple scholarships, the university will grant only the scholarship with the highest
value, ensuring fairness and adherence to the university's guidelines.

b. The students who are eligible for the scholarship as per the norms specified by the University should address
their application to the Registrar with relevant documents for consideration by 31st October of each academic
year or any other deadline communicated by the University.

c. If a student is found involved in any unlawful activities (such as participating in protests, Vandalism,
harassment, etc.), the scholarship will be withdrawn for the current semester, and no scholarship will be
granted in subsequent semesters.

d. If student breaches discipline as outlined in the Discipline and Conduct Rules of the university, the scholarship
will be immediately withdrawn, and no scholarship will be granted in subsequent semesters

€. Scores / Marks / Grades / Ranks are required for award of scholarship should be without any Back /

f,  Ifatany stage, it is found that an applicant has concealed, suppressed, distorted any information / facts which
would have rendered him / her not eligible for the admission and / or for benefit of fee / scholarship which
has been awarded by the University basis initial documentation, then the admission and / or benefit of fee /
scholarship will stand cancelled, and all such financial support will be recovered by the University.

g. In case of any escalation / representation / dispute / discrepancy / clarification, the decision of the Vice
Chancellor will be final and binding.

h. The Management reserves the right to change the scholarship policy as per its discretion.

i. If there is any further confirmed disciplinary violation, the scholarship will be discontinued permanently. The
student will not be eligible for the award of scholarship for subsequent years, if any.

If a student who is offered scholarship decides to withdraw admission, he / she will be treated as per UGC /

University’s applicable refund policy.
